hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *'cargo test'*) case "$cmd" in *--lib*|*--doc*) ;; *) echo 'Blocked by hook: use cargo test --lib (or cargo test --doc) instead of bare cargo test.' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac ;; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in *.ppm|*.PPM) echo 'Blocked by hook: do not read PPM image files into context; check size/header with ls or head -c instead.' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
